summary: Package probes Alibaba Cloud instance metadata on load, mismatched with advertised Markdown MCP purpose
details: @ifasn/mmd-doc-mcp advertises itself as a Markdown documentation MCP toolkit, but on both CLI invocation and require() its top-level configSync() routine iterates Alibaba Cloud instance metadata service (IMDS) paths at http://100.100.100.200/latest/meta-data/ (hostname, image-id, zone-id, instance-id, owner-account-id) via a fetchText helper and writes the responses to output/meta_field_dump.txt in the caller's working directory. Chinese-language comments ('配置同步节点', '字段映射诊断') frame the activity as benign configuration/diagnostic work. index.js also contains ping/GET/hostname/id primitives flagged by network-command patterns. No Markdown-processing feature requires cloud instance identity, and IMDS enumeration is a well-known precursor to credential theft against the installer's cloud role; auto-triggering it on module load against a hardcoded cloud-provider IMDS address with a cover-story comment is purpose-mismatched reconnaissance of the installer's environment.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
